method: Read-only current Atlassian Marketplace, official economics, Forge scope/security and data-residency review.
hypothesis: A Forge/Rovo access-review evidence assistant has a repeated unmet workflow absent from direct substitutes.

covered_capabilities: Jira and Confluence access reviews, decisions and remediation
Risk checks for privileged, inactive and external users
Snapshots, diffs, sign-off and hash-chained/append-only evidence
observed.native_substitute: Atlassian Guard supplies SCIM lifecycle, organization audit logs, policies, detections and remediation.

economics_model.warning: No evidence supports acquiring three paying sites; Atlassian does not remit until accrued partner profit reaches USD 500.

security_boundary: Access topology requires sensitive user/group/project/space/role scopes; remediation adds administrative writes. Rovo actions require explicit authorization and prompt-injection defenses. Tenant isolation, PII-safe logging, residency declarations and egress controls remain developer responsibilities.
reason: Seven exact low-adoption substitutes already cover the workflow, a dense adjacent market and native Guard capabilities constrain the wedge, and no review corpus or buyer evidence establishes demand.
reopening_conditions: Three independent public complaints identify the same missing workflow.
A direct substitute reaches at least 100 installs and reviews validate demand while exposing a common narrow failure.
An authoritative Atlassian API/RBAC change enables an unavailable capability.
Three qualified buyers pre-commit at least USD 75/site/month.
